title: A complete media cabinet project
intro: An integrated media-unit package connects viewing needs, equipment, structure, services, quantities and inspection. Make every change traceable across the documents it affects.
goals: Freeze the project brief and references

sections.title: Freeze the project brief and references
sections.text: Record users, viewing position, device models, storage and site survey. Separate confirmed data from assumptions; an unselected device size must not become a manufacturing release. Refer back to screen and unit decisions, and assign substrate, fixing and service reviews. An attractive elevation does not establish equipment compatibility or wall suitability.
sections.caption: Show unresolved inputs explicitly before drawing release.

sections.title: Link geometry, quantities and services
sections.text: Use the same unit codes in plan, elevation, section and parts list. Show structure, finish build-up and service paths, linking materials to products, samples and edges. A deeper device may affect the compartment, back, cable space, shelf and cut parts. Update affected documents under one revision; changing only the presentation elevation leaves a conflicting package.
sections.caption: One change can affect several coordinated documents.

sections.title: Prepare installation and acceptance checks
sections.text: Plan delivery, assembly and fixing/service checks before closure. Assign references and reviewers for motion, alignment, finish, ventilation and maintenance access. Secure equipment and furniture using the approved system and substrate conditions; weight alone does not prove tip-over resistance. Handover includes final drawings, product identities, care instructions and outstanding items.
sections.caption: A coordinated package includes evidence and unresolved items.

example.title: Worked case and decision
example.text: A deeper device replaces the selected model after the elevation is approved. Review section, connections, ventilation and affected parts, then issue a coordinated revision. The finish sample may remain valid if that system is unchanged, but it does not establish that the new equipment fits.
example.decision: Decision: revise affected documents and verify them before production release.

quiz.question: What needs review when a deeper device is selected?
quiz.explanation: Equipment depth affects geometry, service space and potentially part dimensions.

assignment.prompt: Prepare the package index, a device-change record and three referenced inspection items.

faq.question: Is an elevation enough for manufacturing release?
faq.answer: No. Coordinated sections, details, parts, materials and services are also needed.
